description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul praises God, who chose, redeemed and sealed believers in Jesus with the promised Holy Spirit. He prays that they may know the hope, the inheritance and the power of God that raised Jesus and set Jesus over all things.
1.sw: Paulo anamsifu Mungu, aliyewachagua, kuwakomboa na kuwatia muhuri waamini katika Yesu kwa Roho Mtakatifu aliyeahidiwa. Anaomba wapate kujua tumaini, urithi na nguvu ya Mungu iliyomfufua Yesu na kumweka Yesu juu ya vitu vyote.
1.am: ጳውሎስ አማኞችን በኢየሱስ የመረጠውን፣ የዋጀውንና በተስፋው መንፈስ ቅዱስ ያተመውን እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል። ተስፋውን፣ ርስቱንና ኢየሱስን ከሙታን አስነሥቶ ከሁሉ በላይ ያስቀመጠውን የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል እንዲያውቁ ይጸልያል።

2.en: Once dead in sins, believers have been made alive and saved by grace through faith, not by works. Jesus has made Jews and Gentiles one new people, breaking down the wall between them and bringing both to God.
2.sw: Zamani walikuwa wafu katika dhambi, lakini waamini wamefanywa hai na kuokolewa kwa neema kupitia imani, si kwa matendo. Yesu amewafanya Wayahudi na watu wa mataifa kuwa watu wapya wamoja, akibomoa ukuta uliokuwa kati yao na kuwaleta wote wawili kwa Mungu.
2.am: አማኞች ቀድሞ በኃጢአት ሙታን ነበሩ፤ አሁን ግን በሥራ ሳይሆን በጸጋ በእምነት በኩል ሕያዋን ሆነዋል፣ ድነዋልም። ኢየሱስ በመካከላቸው የነበረውን ግድግዳ አፍርሶ አይሁድንና አሕዛብን አንድ አዲስ ሕዝብ አድርጓቸዋል፤ ሁለቱንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር አቅርቧቸዋል።

3.en: Paul's task is to make known the mystery that the Gentiles are fellow heirs in the gospel. He kneels in prayer that they may grasp the love of Jesus, which surpasses knowledge.
3.sw: Kazi ya Paulo ni kuifanya ijulikane siri kwamba watu wa mataifa ni warithi pamoja katika Injili. Anapiga magoti akiomba wapate kuufahamu upendo wa Yesu, unaopita maarifa.
3.am: የጳውሎስ ተግባር አሕዛብ በወንጌል አብረው ወራሾች መሆናቸውን የሚገልጸውን ምሥጢር ማሳወቅ ነው። ከእውቀት በላይ የሆነውን የኢየሱስን ፍቅር እንዲያስተውሉ ተንበርክኮ ይጸልያል።

4.en: Believers are to keep the unity the Spirit gives, since there is one body and one Spirit, and the gifts are given for building up the body. They must strip off the old self, put on the new, and live as members of one another.
4.sw: Waamini wanapaswa kudumisha umoja anaoutoa Roho, kwa kuwa kuna mwili mmoja na Roho mmoja, na karama zimetolewa ili kuujenga mwili. Lazima wauvue utu wa kale, wauvae ule mpya, na kuishi kama viungo vya mmoja kwa mwingine.
4.am: አንድ አካልና አንድ መንፈስ ስላለ አማኞች መንፈስ የሚሰጠውን አንድነት ሊጠብቁ ይገባቸዋል፤ ስጦታዎችም የተሰጡት አካሉን ለማነጽ ነው። አሮጌውን ሰው አውልቀው አዲሱን መልበስና እርስ በርሳቸው የአንዱ አካል ብልቶች ሆነው መኖር አለባቸው።

5.en: Believers are to live as children of light, imitating God and walking in love. Paul urges them to live wisely, filled with the Spirit, submitting to one another, and describes how wives and husbands are to love and honor each other.
5.sw: Waamini wanapaswa kuishi kama watoto wa nuru, wakimwiga Mungu na kuenenda katika upendo. Paulo anawahimiza waishi kwa hekima, wakiwa wamejazwa Roho, wakinyenyekeana, na kueleza jinsi wake na waume wanavyopaswa kupendana na kuheshimiana.
5.am: አማኞች እግዚአብሔርን እየመሰሉና በፍቅር እየተመላለሱ እንደ ብርሃን ልጆች መኖር ይገባቸዋል። ጳውሎስ በጥበብ እንዲኖሩ፣ በመንፈስ እንዲሞሉ፣ እርስ በርሳቸውም እንዲገዙ ያሳስባቸዋል፤ ሚስቶችና ባሎች እንዴት እርስ በርሳቸው ሊዋደዱና ሊከባበሩ እንደሚገባም ይገልጻል።

6.en: Paul instructs children and parents, slaves and masters. Believers must put on God's complete armor to stand against the devil, and Paul sends Tychicus with news and closes with a blessing.
6.sw: Paulo anawapa maagizo watoto na wazazi, watumwa na mabwana. Waamini lazima wavae silaha kamili za Mungu ili wasimame dhidi ya Ibilisi, naye Paulo anamtuma Tikiko na habari na kumalizia kwa baraka.
6.am: ጳውሎስ ለልጆችና ለወላጆች፣ ለባሪያዎችና ለጌቶች መመሪያ ይሰጣል። አማኞች ዲያብሎስን ተቋቁመው እንዲቆሙ የእግዚአብሔርን ሙሉ የጦር ዕቃ መልበስ አለባቸው፤ ጳውሎስም ቲኪቆስን ከወሬ ጋር ይልካል፤ በበረከትም ይደመድማል።
